new_finding.cause: envelope accepts a nonempty error whose decoded UTF-8 length is64KiB, but Journal.emit rejects any encoded non-raw frame above64KiB. finishKind copies the accepted HTTP/transport error verbatim into item_end.error; even the error-only JSON member exceeds the whole frame cap. JSON control escaping can expand the accepted64KiB string to~384KiB.
source_trace: A one-item closed policy with one small request is admitted with ample32MiB store/8MiB ledger capacity.
A bounded valid429 fixture envelope with65,536 ASCII x error bytes or65,536 NUL bytes is returned. Both exact raw envelopes fit512KiB.
The envelope is persisted, validates, and becomes a captured terminal;353 permits the bounded error.

finishKind produces statuserror and copies last.error. item_end encoded JSON is larger than64KiB; new per-control-frame check refuses before writing, producing uncertainty. This is a collector schema/bound mismatch, not an observed disk failure.

Add bounded regression(s) at the accepted error limit including control escaping, showing a consistent final capture/replay or explicit reproducible raw refusal; no local reviewer job requested.
